title: How to Build a Time Tracking App With AI (Toggl Alternative in Hours)
summary: Build a custom time tracking app with billable rates, invoice generation, and team reports — no code required. Own it forever. No $9/seat/month Toggl fees.
body_markdown: Toggl is built for the average workflow. A custom build gives you your specific billing rates per client, your invoice format, your approval flow — and profitability reporting without the $18/seat Premium upgrade. You build it once and own it at any team size.
